summary:
🚀 Driving growth at the intersection of product innovation, VC, and policy.

Innovation&Growth: Led product innovation, branding, business intelligence, sustainability, and leadership development initiatives that accelerated company growth across multiple businesses. 

VC: Managed the full M&A lifecycle—from due diligence to board membership and successful exits. 

Policy: Active in shaping digital policy to foster a level playing field for European tech.

Academic: PhD in Information Sciences (LMU Munich & Columbia) with research on recommender systems; CDTM alumna with three graduate degrees in technology management, business administration and business research. 

I’m always open to conversations to scale European (tech) ventures sustainably.

company.description:
Acton Capital is a leading European growth-stage venture capital firm with a presence in Munich and Vancouver. Since 1999, the Acton team invests in tech-enabled business models across industries, to create value for the long run. 
With more than two decades of investment experience, Acton Capital has supported +100 startups on their way to market leadership, incl. global category leaders like AlphaSights, Clio, HomeToGo or Mambu.
